title: Aqua ERP
summary: A custom ERP that runs orders, stock, production and dispatch in one place.
problem: Orders, stock and dispatch were tracked across separate Excel sheets and phone calls. Nobody had one view of what was pending, what was in stock and what had shipped.
solution: A custom ERP built around the way the team already works: order entry, stock movement, production status, dispatch and owner reports, with role-based access for office and floor staff.

features.title: Order to dispatch flow
features.description: Every order moves through clear stages with who-did-what history.

features.title: Live stock
features.description: Stock updates automatically on purchase, production and dispatch.

features.title: Owner dashboard
features.description: Today's sales, pending orders and low-stock alerts on one screen.

features.title: Roles and permissions
features.description: Office, floor and owner each see only what they need.

aiNote: AI helped draft the data model, generate screens and write test data, so more time went into understanding the client's process.
results: One system replaced the scattered sheets
Owner sees the day's position without calling anyone
